title: WNBA PRA Repair V1 Step 3 — Page 3 Data Completeness
root_causes: Page 3 coupled opponent identity to a qualified consumer-card match although selected-game truth already proves the opponent.
The Game Center role row carried L5/L10 production and usage evidence but dropped it before the selected-player snapshot reached Page 3.
The Page-3 presentation hardcoded pace and usage placeholders instead of exposing existing PRA V3.6 pace context and role-engine usage evidence.
H2H matching received no opponent key whenever consumer qualification was absent.
patch: Activate a reversible Step-3 overlay above the merged Step-2 team-identity runtime. Preserve role-row L5/L10 and usage fields, derive opponent from selected-game truth, use verified role-row aggregate fallback when history is missing, reuse PRA V3.6 pace context, and pass canonical opponent identity into H2H matching.
closeout_note: Task ledger is DONE for PR action-ledger contract only. GREEN + FROZEN remains unclaimed until exact-head, DevSystem final gate, exact-head merge, merged-main production proof, terminal receipt, and lease release complete.

proof_closeout_trigger.reason: Step 2 is GREEN + FROZEN, so Step 3 downstream proof is legally released. This ledger receipt pairs with the non-runtime Step-3 upstream-release contract test and satisfies the V2 action-ledger requirement for exactly one changed task ledger.

forward_port.reason: Non-overlapping main drift after exact-head proof; Step 2A forward-port preserves only the Step-3 test + ledger diff.

player_ready_verifier_repair_r1.observable_signal: Step-3 Game Center shell became visible before player controls were ready, producing no_tappable_players on every candidate date.
player_ready_verifier_repair_r1.root_cause: Step-3 production cert used a 12-second shell-only readiness helper, while the frozen Step-2 canonical Game Center proof waits for player-control readiness and previously required 21.547 seconds on 2026-10-02.
patch: Replace shell-only readiness with canonical nav._wait_page(page, "game") player-control readiness.
Reuse repository-established 120-second Game Center and Player setup bounds.
Add focused regression proof preventing shell-only Step-3 production certification.

bounded_production_verifier_repair_r2.observable_signal: The single authoritative Page-3 proof consumed the full 35-minute job window and was cancelled before emitting production evidence.
bounded_production_verifier_repair_r2.root_cause: Step-3 searched multiple candidate dates and multiple games while allowing up to 120 seconds for Game Center plus 120 seconds for Player readiness on each attempt, so verifier fan-out could exceed the workflow budget without proving a product failure.
patch: Use the canonical current WNBA date from nav._find_game_date() instead of scanning historical candidate dates.
Bound each date to at most two real games.
Bound Game Center and Player readiness to 90 seconds each.
Reduce outer deployment attempts to two with a five-second retry pause.
Preserve canonical player-ready nav._wait_page contracts and make no product/runtime/model changes.

direct_evidence: Step-3 proof entered WNBA/PRA successfully and selected the 2026-10-02 WNBA slate.
After clicking Open Game Center, the visible body reported MLB Live Odds / Run Line instead of WNBA Game Center.
The frozen WNBA navigation writer persisted only wnba_pra_* deep-route state while the universal shell defaults to MLB when its sport widget state is not preserved.
deep_route_shell_lock_r1.root_cause: The Game/Player rerun did not carry an explicit WNBA/PRA universal-shell handoff, allowing the shell to fall back to MLB even though WNBA deep-navigation state remained valid.
patch: Keep the frozen WNBA navigation module unchanged.
In the non-frozen Step-3 overlay, pin ks_sport_touch=WNBA and ks_wnba_market_touch=PRA whenever WNBA navigation is at Game or Player depth.
Persist ks_jump_sport=WNBA and ks_jump_market=PRA alongside deep-route query writes so a rerun/new shell session retains route ownership.
Restore the original navigation query writer after each render.
